title: TextEDA IR v0.13 — system shard
description: Multi-board connections: system-level nets between boards. Members only reference board ports, never pins, and never rewrite any board's internal connectivity. See ADR-0001.

format.description: Language version of the .teda file that produced this shard.

source.description: Source-file location: path relative to the project root plus an optional line number.

system.description: System id, identifying one multi-board system.

boards.description: List of boards participating in this system.

id.description: System-level net name, independent of in-board net names.

members.description: Members of this system-level net: port references of the boards.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute.
